producer_report.summary: Raised the reader, producer, verifier, planner and critic time limits in athena.toml to 86400 s (24 h) and check_timeout_s to 14400 s (4 h, a hung-test guard). Updated the repository-config pins in config.rs, the hard-coded 1800 in the check-deadline test (run/tests.rs) to 14400, and made that test's expected message derive from the limit. Added a Changed entry to CHANGELOG.md. No config validation caps were found, so none were changed. Targeted tests, fmt and the policy scan pass; clippy and the full suite are left to Athena's checks.
